title: Cedar Hollow October family newsletter
brief: Dr. Lucia Hernandez, principal of Cedar Hollow Elementary, wants the October family newsletter as a web page, mostly read by parents on their phones. Warm, brief and easy to scan. Headings: "Dates to remember", "Reading challenge", "Drop-off and pick-up" and "Thank you". Dates: parent-teacher conferences on 2026-11-05 and 2026-11-06 from 15:30 to 19:00, with online booking opening on 2026-10-26; the Book Fair from 2026-11-09 to 2026-11-13 in the library; no school on 2026-11-11 (Veterans Day) and from 2026-11-25 to 2026-11-27 (Thanksgiving break). Reading challenge: the whole school set a goal of 60000 minutes read by 2026-12-18 and has logged 21400 so far, with Room 12 (Ms. Okafor's class) in the lead at 3150 minutes; reading logs go in the red folder every Friday. Drop-off and pick-up: the lane opens at 07:45 and the bell is at 08:15; no left turns out of the lot onto Alder Street; please use the east lot for pick-up; students must be picked up by 15:45 or they go to the after-school office, which charges 5 dollars per 15 minutes. Thank you: to the 38 volunteers who ran the Fall Fair, which raised 9640 dollars for the library, and to the families who sent in 412 cans of food for the neighborhood pantry.

edit.request: Change the reading goal to 75000 minutes and the conference start time to 16:00, and add the line "Winter concert: 2026-12-10 at 18:30 in the gym".
